4.1. Methods
A total of 184 participants were recruited via a British online
recruitment platform, Proliﬁc Academic. One participant was
removed from the ﬁnal analyses for not completing the manipu-
lation in full. The ﬁnal sample consisted of 183 participants, 110
females and 73 males, aged between 18 and 71 (M ¼ 30.15,
SD ¼ 10.70). Participants were randomly assigned to either the
experimental (n ¼ 91) or control condition (n ¼ 92). The manipu-
lations were identical to that in Study 1. Participants in the exper-
